description: This file defines the SubunitTreeModel class, which constructs a hierarchical tree representation of organizational subunits from an array of Subunit entities. It serializes the data into a nested array suitable for API responses, including properties like id, unitId, name, level, and children.

classes.name: SubunitTreeModel
classes.description: A model that converts an array of Subunit entities into a nested tree structure for API serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an array of Subunit entities.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the subunit collection into a tree structure array.

methods.name: toTree
methods.description: Private method that builds a nested hierarchical array of subunits based on their levels.
